Hi Asha —

Appreciate the clarity. Attaching a working MAP (redwood_map_praxis_v1.xlsx) that breaks the plan into discrete security/compliance milestones and owners. Key highlights up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA; we typically share through a secure bucket.
- SIG/CAIQ: we request Praxis to send your completed SIG first; we'll return completed answers and evidence items within 5 business days.
- DPA: Redwood supports SCCs for EU transfers and can accept a limited set of redlines; we include subprocessors and KMS options in the DPA appendix.
- Retention: default runtime payload retention is 90 days for hosted customers; enterprise options include configurable retention and bring-your-own-storage for longer custody. Audit logs can be retained up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private plans.

Proposed MAP timeline (high level):
Week 0 (this week): exchange SIG, DPA redlines, and NDA for SOC2 access
Week 1: Redwood returns completed SIG answers + SOC 2 share, initial legal redline review
Week 2: Security deep-dive + evidence handoff call; resolve outstanding 3rd-party/subprocessor asks
Week 3: Finalize DPA and contract; pilot activation on dedicated pool

Owners: Laura Bennett will shepherd SOC2/evidence, Connor O'Brien will run the security deep-dive and technical evidence handoff.

Suggested kickoff: Tue Nov 9, 10:30am PT. Does that work for your team?

Next steps: Please send Praxis' SIG spreadsheet and the specific DPA clauses you'd like us to review (we can take redlines directly).

Rafael Mendes

Hi Asha — thanks for the SIG and the early DPA notes. Quick answers to your Qs and our proposed positions: 

1) Prompt/Customer Content Storage:
- Hosted (default): transient caching is used for inference performance; persistent storage of prompt payloads is OFF by default for accounts on our standard hosted plan. For customers that enable logging, we retain request/response payloads for 90 days by default.
- Enterprise/Dedicated: we offer configurable retention windows (30d, 90d, 12mo, or customer-controlled via BYOS object store). If Praxis requires non-default persistence, we can configure a 12-month retention window for payloads for the pilot and discuss long-term options.

2) Audit logs and exports:
- Audit logs capture authentication events, API request metadata (timestamp, request_id, model_version, token counts), and system-level alerts. We do NOT store full prompt content in the standard audit log unless payload logging is explicitly enabled.
- For long-term retention: on Dedicated/Private we provide an immutable export to an S3-compatible bucket or Glacier for archival. We can export the approved subset of transaction metadata to an immutable store for 7 years; we will need to scope which fields Praxis needs retained.

3) SOC 2 report:
- Current report: SOC 2 Type II covering 2025-09-01 through 2026-03-31. There are no open exceptions we track as material; we'll share the report under NDA.

DPA & Transfers: Redwood supports EU SCCs in our DPA and can accept Praxis' carrier redlines subject to standard carveouts around subprocessors and security thresholds. We also provide an EU-hosting option for data residency on Dedicated or Private deployments.

Call logistics: Nov 10 09:00am PT for a 60-minute technical deep-dive (security + engineering). Connor will lead the evidence walkthrough and demo of how audit exports work; Soojin will cover DPA/subprocessor and encryption details. I've attached a calendar placeholder here: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/meet/ra/laura-connor-nov10
